reviews.comment:
El servicio del chico del full (Xavier) es excelente. El pibe se banca solo todo. Atiende la gente del motel, full y los clientes que dejan las del restaurante malondonas que te cierran la puerta en la cara, ni te contestan una simple pregunta, y te miran con cara de orto. La concesión del restaurante que se la den a otro. Todo mérito del pibe.

(Translated by Google)
The service from the guy at the motel (Xavier) is excellent. He handles everything himself. He serves the motel staff, the regulars, and the customers left by the restaurant staff—those awful women who slam the door in your face, won't answer a simple question, and give you a dirty look. They should give the restaurant concession to someone else. All credit goes to the guy.
